svg.title: The daily chain - guards, stages, the publish gate and the traps

g.text: The daily chain - guards, stages, the publish gate and the traps
prologue: digest from task metadata when unset (JDL-147),
run stamp set-if-unset (JDL-148); arguments other than --inner
are exec'd instead of the chain (JDL-149)
failure: the hard cap sends TERM after 3600 s and KILL 60 s later
inner run: bucket required (JDL-151); sources events.sh and dashboard.sh,
cd JEF_APP_DIR (JDL-152); TERM trap emits rc 143, EXIT trap publishes
failure: a non-zero restore exit stops the chain
exit with the sync status, nothing published
status exit status and the JSON teed to status.json
[for each asset until the first failing one]
failure: a non-zero binning exit is emitted, then ends the loop
asset exit status and optional run manifest
jef_emit(stage_binning, rc, t0, t1, asset, manifest)
failure: any non-zero aws exit stops the publish
owner: data-load — realises JDL-146, JDL-147, JDL-148, JDL-149, JDL-150, JDL-151, JDL-152, JDL-153, JDL-154, JDL-155, JDL-156, JDL-157, JDL-158
